post.description:
Submit a message written by one of **your** users and let the Shortext agent answer it.

**Reply modes**
- `sync`: the request waits for the agent reply (max ~25 s) and returns it in `body.replies`.
  On timeout `body.status` is `pending` and the reply is delivered to your webhook.
- `async`: the request returns immediately with `accepted`; replies are delivered to your webhook.

**Idempotency**: `message.id` is your own message id. Sending the same id again returns
`duplicate` with the original message, without a second reply.

**Webhook**: replies (async, sync timeout, human agent answers) are POSTed to the endpoint
webhook as `message.sent` events (`ShortextWebhookEvent` body), signed with
`X-Shortext-Signature: sha256=hex(hmac_sha256(secret, "{X-Shortext-Timestamp}.{raw_body}"))`.
Retried for ~21 h on failure; dedupe on the event `id`.

TOKEN_USER_NOT_FOUND.description: The user associated with the token was not found / L'utilisateur associé au token n'a pas été trouvé.

ShortextWebhookEvent.description:
Body POSTed to the endpoint webhook (same format as every Shortext webhook).
Headers: X-Shortext-Event, X-Shortext-Delivery, X-Shortext-Timestamp, X-Shortext-Signature, X-Shortext-Api-Version.
Answer with a 2xx within 10 s; failed deliveries are retried for ~21 h. Dedupe on `id`.
